W_shacl_gate_keeps_its_own_lf_only_regex._note: #4459 WIRING: the pre-fix predicate back in place. C1 (CRLF) and C2 (BOM) redden — the gate returns `null` ("nothing to validate") and the violating candidate is waved through, the false negative the issue names. C3 (valid CRLF candidate) is an ABSENCE-of-violation axis and is legitimately green in both directions; C4 (no block at all) is unaffected by tolerance. ⛤ E3 (the ratchet) reddens under this mutant AND under every other WIRING mutant of this work item, and that was NOT in the first prediction — it was derived from the mutant's THEME rather than from which axes EXECUTE after it lands (integration-test-revert-verify §A44). The reason is structural and is good news: each WIRING mutant re-introduces the literal `/^---\n` into `packages/cli/src`, which is exactly the form E3 asserts is extinct. So E3 is a live ratchet with a demonstrated flip, not a pin — it would be satisfiable by a broken grep otherwise, and its own canary only proves the predicate, not that anything can trip it.
